events.title: Oliver Wyman 收购 Synpulse：1200 人金融科技与 AI 咨询公司并入，押注 AI 金融服务咨询

events.summary_en: On Nov 19, 2026, Marsh's Oliver Wyman agreed to acquire Synpulse (~1,200 staff), combining strategy with technology and AI engineering delivery for financial services; closing expected early 2027. The heaviest single capital move on the board this week.
